Subject: Project Zenith is a set of email practices

Hi John,

I hope this email finds you well! I wanted to share an exciting initiative we’re implementing to improve communication efficiency across our team. Project Zenith is a set of structured email practices designed to reduce clutter, enhance clarity, and boost productivity. Here’s a quick overview of what Project Zenith entails:

- Priority-Based Structuring: Emails are tagged as Critical, Important, or Informational to help prioritize responses.
- Clear and Concise Subject Lines: Ensure your subject lines accurately reflect the content of your email.
